constraints.definition: CHECK (bound_owner_id IS NULL AND identity_revision IS NULL OR bound_owner_id IS NOT NULL AND identity_revision IS NOT NULL)

CHECK (disposition = 'accepted'::text AND (event_kind = ANY (ARRAY['message'::text, 'callback'::text])) AND private_input IS NOT NULL AND ignored_reason IS NULL OR disposition = 'ignored'::text AND event_kind = 'ignored'::text AND private_input IS NULL AND ignored_reason IS NOT NULL)

CHECK (recipient_kind = 'account'::text AND owner_id IS NOT NULL AND session_id IS NOT NULL OR recipient_kind = 'legacy_subscription'::text AND source_kind = 'campaign'::text AND owner_id IS NULL AND session_id IS NULL AND recipient_ref::text ~~ 'legacy:%'::text)
CHECK (recipient_kind = 'account'::text AND owner_id IS NOT NULL OR recipient_kind = 'legacy_subscription'::text AND owner_id IS NULL)

CHECK (status = 'processed'::text AND canonical_receipt IS NOT NULL AND receipt IS NOT NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL OR status = 'held'::text AND receipt IS NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['leased'::text, 'dispatching'::text, 'uncertain'::text])) AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND receipt IS NULL)
